decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the erection of a  
           garage, because of its position, design and appearance, would be 
           acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 31 
           Brentwick Gardens and is complementary to the visual amenity of the 
           locality and would not be detrimental to the amenities of adjoining and 
           neighbouring  properties.  The development is in accordance with 
           Policy ENV-B 1.1 (New Development) and T 4.4  (Road Safety) 
           of the London Borough of  Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the garage is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west walls of the garage hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on drawing No. 31BG/01/B shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.

Condition : 6 - Informative
This permission relates to the erection of the garage only and does not include the rear fence, facing onto Carville Crescent, for which another Planning Application may be required.
description: Erection of single storey detached garage in rear end of garden to house.
